purpose: Archival reconciliation, not review evidence or authorization to replay re-chained historical invocations.
restoration: For each source: take base.records[0:shared_prefix_records], append original_tail, serialize {schema, records} with JSON.stringify(value,null,2) plus one newline. SHA-256 must equal source sha256. Destination mappings are archival only; never rewrite original invocation pins or verdicts.
